title: Religious Life and Customs
summary: --Religious life and customs is free-floating under names of countries, cities, etc. It is never followed by --History; established period subdivisions may follow it, and new ones may be established except under cities or towns. Customs of an individual religion in a place take [religion or denomination]--[place]--Customs and practices plus [place]--Religious life and customs.
validation_rules: `--Religious life and customs` is free-floating under names of countries, cities, etc., e.g. `Brazil--Religious life and customs`, `New York (N.Y.)--Religious life and customs`. (H 2016 sec. 1)
Do not use `--History` after `--Religious life and customs`. (H 2016 sec. 2)
Established period subdivisions may follow: `[place]--Religious life and customs--[period subdivision]`, e.g. `Germany--Religious life and customs--Middle Ages, 843-1517`. (H 2016 sec. 2)
New period subdivisions may be established under `[place]--Religious life and customs` except when the place is a city or town. (H 2016 sec. 2)

Customs of an individual religion or denomination in a place: `[religion or denomination]--Customs and practices` (with place, e.g. `Catholic Church--Mexico--Customs and practices`) plus `[place]--Religious life and customs`. (H 2016 sec. 3)

sections.heading: 1. General
sections.text:
Assign the free-floating subdivision --Religious life and customs under names of countries, cities, etc. Examples:

```
651 #0 $a Asia $x Religious life and customs.
651 #0 $a Brazil $x Religious life and customs.
651 #0 $a California $x Religious life and customs.
651 #0 $a New York (N.Y.) $x Religious life and customs.
```

sections.heading: 2. By period
sections.text:
Do not use the subdivision --History after --Religious life and customs (see H 1647). If period subdivisions have been established and are appropriate for the work, assign headings of the type [place]--Religious life and customs--[period subdivision] to works on the history of the religious customs, etc., in a place during a particular period. Example:

```
651 #0 $a Germany $x Religious life and customs $y Middle Ages, 843-1517.
```

Establish new period subdivisions under headings of the type [place]--Religious life and customs as needed, except if the place in question is a city or town.

sections.heading: 3. By religion or denomination
sections.text:
Assign headings of the type [religion or denomination]--Customs and practices and [place]--Religious life and customs to works on the customs and practices of an individual religion or denomination in a particular place. Example:

```
Title: Popular expressions of Catholicism in Mexico today.
610 20 $a Catholic Church $z Mexico $x Customs and practices.
651 #0 $a Mexico $x Religious life and customs.
```
